meta.title: Home
meta.description: The information center and educational visit for Ijen Geopark geology in Banyuwangi, Indonesia. Check availability and book your visit to PIGGI online.

hero.judul: See Ijen up close, then try it yourself.
hero.lead: Discover the geology, nature, and culture of Ijen Geopark. At PIGGI, you can observe, experiment, and play hands-on.

cta.judul: Ready to see it for real?
cta.teks: Pick a date, check what's left, and book your visit. Check-in and payment (if any) happen at PIGGI.

meta.title: About PIGGI
meta.description: What PIGGI is, its history, role, and goals as the geological information center of Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi.

cta.judul: Now that you know us, come by.
cta.teks: See opening hours, location, and visit availability.

meta.title: Explore PIGGI
meta.description: PIGGI floor map: each floor tells one chapter of the Ijen story, from how it formed to its people and culture.

cta.teks: See the activities and games you'll only find at PIGGI.

meta.title: Hands-on
meta.description: Hands-on activities and games at PIGGI: observe, experiment, and collect Geologist Passport stamps during your visit.

cta.judul: This one you have to try in person.
cta.teks: Book a visit slot and experience it yourself.

meta.title: For Schools
meta.description: School group visits to PIGGI by level, links to the curriculum, and downloadable worksheets.

cta.teks: Book a group slot and register interest in the escape room.

meta.title: Quiz, Gallery & Events
meta.description: A warm-up quiz before visiting PIGGI, a photo gallery, and upcoming events. Redeem your quiz code when you visit.

cta.teks: Redeem it at PIGGI for a bonus Geologist Passport stamp.

meta.description: Check availability per session and book your visit to PIGGI in Banyuwangi. Location, opening hours, contact, and FAQ.
